theorems.name: Submission.egorov_closed_subset_uniformOn_compact_volume
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (η : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → ℝ) (S : Set (Rn n)), (∀ k, Measurable (η k)) → Measurable g → MeasurableSet S → (∀ x ∈ S, Tendsto (fun k => η k x) atTop (𝓝 (g x))) → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ A ⊆ S, IsClosed A ∧ volume (S \ A) < ε ∧ ∀ Q : Set (Rn n), IsCompact Q → Q ⊆ A → TendstoUniformlyOn η g atTop Q
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
